title: Privacy Policy
intro: This Privacy Policy explains how WSMath handles information when you visit our website or contact us.

sections.heading: What we collect
sections.body: If you contact us (e.g. via WhatsApp), we may receive information you provide such as your name, contact details, school year, and message content.

sections.heading: How we use information
sections.body: We use information to respond to enquiries, schedule lessons, and provide tutoring services.

sections.heading: Sharing
sections.body: We do not sell your information. We may use service providers required to operate the website (e.g. hosting), and only when necessary.

sections.heading: Retention & requests
sections.body: We keep enquiry details only as long as needed for communication and service delivery. You may request access to or deletion of your messages by contacting us.
